name: Video Transcriber
tagline: Turns a video link into a clean transcript or subtitle file
description: Paste in a TikTok, YouTube, X or Instagram address and it hands back the words. Take them as plain prose, as a subtitle file ready to drop onto a timeline, or broken up by who is talking. Where the platform already carries captions it works from those, falling back on machine listening only when there are none.
author: habib
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
